**Early access / beta.** Finca Animate is a free, open-source 2D animation studio for Linux and Windows, inspired by Toon Boom Harmony. It's based on [OpenToon Studio](https://github.com/helliott20/opentoon) by helliott20 and contributors (MIT). This is a personal project, shared as-is: things will change, and support is best-effort.

## Download

**Linux:** download `Finca-Animate-1.1.0-beta.2-x86_64.AppImage`, right-click it, open Properties, allow executing as a program, then double-click it. If it doesn't start, your system may be missing `libfuse2`: install that, or use the `.tar.gz` instead (extract it and run `opentoon-studio` inside).

**Windows:** download `Finca-Animate-Setup-1.1.0-beta.2.exe` and run it. The installer isn't code-signed, so Windows SmartScreen will show "Windows protected your PC". Click **More info**, then **Run anyway**.

Already on beta.1? The app will offer this update (on Linux, only after you approve it).

## What's new since beta.1

**Drawing substitution**
- Animation → Drawing Substitution… shows thumbnails of every drawing on the layer (mouths, hands, eyes…), including ones no longer exposed. Swap the current frame, or the rest of the held exposure, in one undoable step.

**Big scenes use far less memory**
- Vector drawings no longer each reserve a full-size image (about 8 MB at 1080p) the moment they exist. They're drawn from their strokes when needed, and drawings far from the playhead are let go again, within a 1 GB budget. A 300-drawing 1080p vector scene used to need about 2.4 GB just to open; now it needs almost none.
- Bitmap drawings are unchanged for now (they're the only copy of their pixels); making those lighter is next.

**Scripting console**
- Help → Scripting Console… runs JavaScript against the open scene (`app` and `OT` are in scope), with undo for app commands. It's an early interface; a stable API is planned.

## Please note

- **Back up anything important.** This is a beta.
- **Scenes use project format 2,** same as beta.1. Don't re-save them in older OpenToon builds, which would drop pivots, curves, art layers and linked swatches.
- **Built with AI coding assistance (Claude).** AI was used for code only; this release adds no AI-generated artwork.
